title: To Select Options
prompt: A TypeScript form component needs select options from records. Write a function that maps each item with id and name to { value: id, label: name }.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For To Select Options, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A TypeScript form component needs select options from records. Write a function that maps each item with id and name to { value: id, label: name }. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in TypeScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure TypeScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is typescript, mapping and forms. Keep the solution direct and easy to read; the main goal is correctness and clear control flow.
